correctness.rationale: The definition is the K3-devoid complex, not ordinary independence. Both graph adjacencies were reconstructed from their explicit Z4^2 step sets; each has 16 vertices of degree six, 48 edges, 32 triangles, and common-neighbor count two. Every one of the 65536 vertex subsets was independently tested for forbidden triangles, yielding 8951 faces including empty for Sh and 7343 for rook. The specified staged greedy Morse matching leaves nine critical six-faces after 4471 pairs (Sh) and fifteen critical five-faces after 3664 pairs (rook), with augmented empty face paired in each. An independently implemented complete directed Hasse topological sort visits all 8951 faces/48288 incidences and all 7343 faces/37744 incidences without cycles. Removing the empty pair leaves one critical vertex and cells only in a single higher dimension: Forman then gives wedges of nine six-spheres and fifteen five-spheres integrally. Modular boundary computations are corroborative, not the source of the homotopy claim.
residual_risks: Rook comparison is fully prior coverage; new topological result restricted to the specified Shrikhande graph, not all strongly regular graphs.
Independent finite computations do not replace the full all-parameter argument where applicable.
